_comment: Site-wide display settings. ONE configured default, read from here and applied everywhere — including the as-of stamp — so that moving to viewer-local time after Week 0 is a change to how this value is RESOLVED rather than a hunt through the codebase for hardcoded zones.
_timezone_note: Pacific, by Marc's decision 2026-08-21. This cuts against convention — ESPN and CBS publish kickoffs in Eastern — which is exactly why AC-G.34's requirement to always show the zone abbreviation is load-bearing. '7:30 PM PDT' is unambiguous; '7:30 PM' is not.
_future: Viewer-local is the eventual answer and was deferred because a custom JS component is a new failure mode days before a season. When it lands, it replaces display_timezone resolution, not the call sites.
